description: Evaluates gate g.g0 … g.g10 against your evidence. Outcome precedence: Stop > Recycle > Hold > Conditional go > Go, with the rule that fired (outcome_reason). Critical evidence missing or stale → Hold; required non-critical missing, or a waiver without a reason or an approver who decides at this gate → Conditional go; a waiver with both → Go with the Waiver modifier (under regulation a waived critical artifact stays Conditional go until the deviation is recorded with the quality approval); optional gaps are notes. Modifiers: Work started without the gate, Overdue, Stale, Waiver. gate.deciders decide, gate.advisors take part. A disproved key product hypothesis is a Recycle, not a Stop: pass earlier_stage_invalid:true with invalid_stage:'st.discovery'. At G8 (go / no-go), work_started_beyond:true means production was changed before the decision: Hold (R3), not a Go with a modifier. Call without evidence to list what the gate needs. Returns a receipt hash of the inputs.

context.description: Project context. Unknown keys and values are rejected in the answer envelope with did_you_mean. Defaults: software, hybrid, complicated, tm, single, medium size, ui, data.

ap.description: Delivery approach: predictive | agile | flow | hybrid

con.description: Contract model: fixed | tm | capped | internal (own budget)

dom.description: Project type: software | package | data | infra | process | nonit. package = SaaS / ERP / CRM platform; nonit = any non-IT project (a launch, a programme, an event, a move: add physical for works on site)

high_stakes.description: A failure hits customers, money, safety or a regulated function: operational readiness and a rehearsed rollback at G8

physical.description: Physical works in any domain: premises, construction, equipment or on-site events (an office move, a fit-out, an event on site). Adds the site inspection (G7), supplier contracts (G5), plan B with a fixed date and the permits note. A non-IT launch, programme or online event is dom=nonit without it

size.description: Project size: solo | small | medium | large, default medium. solo = one person does all the work (small tailoring, no Daily Scrum or Kanban meeting); small ≈ up to 3 months and 5 people in one team; large ≈ several teams, over 12 months or a programme. Small and solo lower some gate documents one level (never under regulation) and drop the steering committee, large raises some

unc.description: Uncertainty (complexity domain): clear | complicated | complex | chaotic

earlier_stage_invalid.description: true → Recycle; the answer names the stage to return to

evidence.description: Map artifact id → state or {state, reason, ref, by, date}. A waiver is {state:'waived', reason, by}: by is the role id of a decider of this gate (see gate.deciders, e.g. r.client_owner) or 'name, role'. Unknown ids are reported as warnings with a suggestion.

grace_days.description: Overrides both limits. Default: 80% of planned_stage_days, else by approach (predictive/hybrid 10, agile/flow 5); required evidence then waits twice as long

invalid_artifact.description: With earlier_stage_invalid: the artifact that is no longer true, to find where to return

invalid_stage.description: With earlier_stage_invalid: the stage to return to, if known

planned_stage_days.description: Planned length of the stage in days. With it, missing critical evidence is overdue after 80% of it and missing required evidence after all of it

work_started_beyond.description: True if work of later stages already started (adds the 'work started without the gate' modifier; at G8 it is a Hold)

name: check_gate
title: Check a gate
